record.original_question: Find conditions insuring that if a sequence of plurisubharmonic functions um → u in C^n then (ddc um )n → (ddc u)n .

evidence.quote: Problem 8.1.1 Find conditions insuring that if a sequence of plurisubharmonic functions um → u in Cn then (ddc um )n → (ddc u)n . 8.2 Extremal Functions

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ be an open set and let $\mathrm{PSH}(\Omega)$ denote the cone of plurisubharmonic functions on $\Omega$. For a locally bounded plurisubharmonic function $u$, the complex Monge-Ampère operator $(dd^c u)^n$ is defined inductively by Bedford-Taylor as the positive Borel measure obtained from the closed positive current $dd^c u \wedge \cdots \wedge dd^c u$ ($n$ times), where $d = \partial +  ar\partial$ and $d^c =  rac{i}{2\pi}( ar\partial - \partial)$.

Problem: Determine general conditions on a sequence $\{u_m\} \subset \mathrm{PSH}(\Omega)$ and a function $u \in \mathrm{PSH}(\Omega)$ with $u_m 	o u$ (in some specified sense on $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$) which guarantee that the Monge-Ampère measures converge weakly:
$$(dd^c u_m)^n \;\longrightarrow\; (dd^c u)^n \quad 	ext{as } m 	o \infty,$$
in the sense of weak convergence of Radon measures on $\Omega$. In particular, identify natural classes of (possibly unbounded) plurisubharmonic functions and modes of convergence (e.g.\ monotone, in capacity, in $L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}$ together with auxiliary uniform bounds) for which this continuity property holds, and exhibit counterexamples showing the sharpness of the imposed conditions.
artifact.status_search_result: This is a long-standing question in pluripotential theory with many partial results. Bedford-Taylor established continuity for monotone sequences of locally bounded plurisubharmonic functions, and Xing, Cegrell, Kolodziej and others have shown that convergence in capacity (with suitable uniform domination) implies weak convergence of the Monge-Ampère measures. Substantial extensions exist within the Cegrell classes $\mathcal{E}_0$, $\mathcal{F}$, $\mathcal{E}$ for unbounded psh functions. Despite these advances, a single complete characterization of all sequences for which $(dd^c u_m)^n \to (dd^c u)^n$ is not known, so the problem in full generality remains active.

status_evidence.title: Convergence in Capacity
status_evidence.snippet: Convergence in capacity of plurisubharmonic functions u_k implies weak convergence of the complex Monge-Ampère measures (dd^c u_k)^n provided uniform lower bounds hold.
status_evidence.claim: Convergence in capacity yields weak convergence of Monge-Ampère measures under suitable domination — a major partial answer.

status_evidence.title: Continuity of the complex Monge-Ampere operator
status_evidence.snippet: Studies continuity properties of (dd^c .)^n on classes of plurisubharmonic functions.
status_evidence.claim: Continuity of the Monge-Ampère operator has been established on specific classes (e.g. Cegrell's classes) but no fully general characterization exists.
